Method of Attack: NULL pointer dereference in man leads to denial of service when a section name is supplied but no page argument is given
Attack Vector: Attacker can control all parameters passed to man

Method of Attack: Out-of-bounds heap read in unlzma leads to information leak and denial of service when crafted LZMA-compressed input is decompressed
Impacted Systems: lzma/unlzma and other applets supporting LZMA compression
Attack Vector: Attacker can supply a crafted compressed file that will be decompressed by using unlzma

Method of Attack: Incorrect handling of a special element in ash leads to denial of service when processing a crafted shell command
Attack Vector: Attacker can supply a command line to ash containing special characters $, {, }, #

Method of Attack: NULL pointer dereference in hush leads to denial of service when processing a crafted shell command
Attack Vector: Attacker can supply a command line to hush containing the special character \x03 (delimiter)

Method of Attack: Attacker-controlled pointer free in hush leads to denial of service and possible code execution when processing a crafted shell command
Attack Vector: Attacker can supply a command line to hush containing the special character &

Method of Attack: Use-after-free in awk leads to denial of service and possibly code execution when processing a crafted awk pattern
Attack Vector: Attacker can supply an arbitrary pattern to awk (the pattern is the first positional argument this applet takes)
